definitions.gloss: sweet vinegar pickle; food pickled in sweetened vinegar
definitions.explanation: Vegetables, fish, or other ingredients preserved by soaking in a mixture of vinegar and sugar. A common side dish and garnish in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢漬|あまずづ}け。
examples.english: Daikon radish pickled in sweet vinegar.

examples.japanese: {新生姜|しんしょうが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢漬|あまずづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made sweet vinegar pickled ginger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢漬|あまずづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。⟦さっぱりして→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, I often eat vegetables pickled in sweet vinegar. They're refreshing and stimulate the appetite.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧ (sweet vinegar) + {漬|づ}け (pickle/preserved). The pickling liquid (⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧) is a mixture of ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar), ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar), and often ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢漬|あまずづ}け: sweet vinegar pickled daikon
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢漬|あまずづ}け: pickled ginger (like the pink ginger served with sushi)
- {甘酢漬|あまずづ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pickle in sweet vinegar
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢漬|あまずづ}け: sweet vinegar pickled vegetables

CULTURAL NOTE:
The pink pickled ginger (⟦ガリ→ガリ：27408_gari⟧) served alongside sushi is a type of {甘酢漬|あまずづ}け. {甘酢漬|あまずづ}け is also a popular way to preserve seasonal vegetables at home.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: pickles — the general term for all Japanese pickled foods
- ⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧: vinegared dish — a broader category of vinegar-dressed dishes
- ⟦{南蛮漬|なんばんづ}け→南蛮漬け：27594_nanbanzuke⟧: nanban-zuke — fried food marinated in sweet vinegar with chili
